**Under the P50 middle historical scenario, your estimated income after the one-third tax assumption and tolled commute is $73,297.66.**

- 🛣️ **Annualized daily-P50 toll scenario:** $11.60 per office day; $2,784.00 annually
- 📉 **Total annual tolled-commute cost under P50:** $6,702.34
- 💵 **Additional gross salary needed to offset:** $10,053.51
- 📊 **P50 tolled-commute share of estimated after-tax income:** 8.4%

| Historical scenario | Per-office-day | Average-monthly | Annual | Remaining income |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| P25 — lower historical scenario | $27.93 | $558.53 | $6,702.34 | $73,297.66 |
| P50 — middle historical scenario | $27.93 | $558.53 | $6,702.34 | $73,297.66 |
| P90 — higher historical scenario | $27.93 | $558.53 | $6,702.34 | $73,297.66 |

#### ⚠️ Assumptions and limitations

- This covers only the tolled portions between the validated priced toll-facility endpoints; every untolled part of the commute is excluded.
- It assumes one-third of gross income goes to taxes; this is not an actual tax calculation.
- Vehicle cost uses TollChat’s fixed **$0.685 per straight-line tolled mile** assumption, not your individualized vehicle expense.
- The estimate uses recent historical toll evidence, with **100.0% coverage** and complete same-date round-trip pairs for the evaluated period. - These are annualized historical daily scenarios—not forecasts, annual percentiles, or probabilities.
